limitations: Two repetitions per feature/loop combination are exploratory, not statistical proof.
The identical conditional prompt enforces treatment use; this is not organic routing.
Local ACP exercises Goose backend, not Electron rendering.
Feature-off still includes developer tools; code_execution and delegated engines are absent.
Permissions constrain fixture files and argv; approved test code is not OS sandboxed.
Requested high effort and returned model/usage metadata are recorded; internal reasoning effort cannot be independently observed.
The direct Google proxy drops temperature, top_p and store consistently with production normalization; dropped key names are recorded.
interpretationNotes: Native tools passed all four required-treatment and independent-oracle runs. Baseline code/test correctness passed three of four rows, although two correct rows were aborted by the fixed benchmark permission grammar rejecting git status variants. The remaining baseline failure was a rejected cat -e variant before edits. Strict run completion is therefore not a general capability-quality ranking.

One HTTP503 was retried successfully and remains included in native legacy row1 latency and request count. Every attempted request model/effort and every successful generation response identity is checked; the original model-assessment change is retained in assessmentRevisions.
No benchmark rows were rerun or removed. The two resume operations continued only unfinished plan rows after validating unchanged prompt, source/test, runtime and binary hashes.

postRunProvenance.note: Fingerprint added after capture from the unchanged permission function sources used for every recorded case. No permission policy or measured outcome was changed.
The reusable harness now exits nonzero when any live row is unaccepted or unfinished. This fix was tested offline after this completed capture; the benchmark was not rerun.
